objective: Test whether allowing more than one sentiment for a selected aspect improves held-out pair F1 or instead loses precision.

data_contract.representation: name_and_description for seen and held-out aspects
data_contract.training_filter: remove every official training row containing the fold's held-out aspect

control_decoder.aspect_threshold_objective: end-to-end pair micro-F1 on seen-aspect validation

multi_sentiment_decoder.sentiment_rule: emit every sentiment_score >= jointly selected sentiment threshold; if none passes, emit the argmax sentiment
multi_sentiment_decoder.threshold_objective: end-to-end pair micro-F1 on seen-aspect validation
multi_sentiment_decoder.aspect_threshold_candidates: all strict candidates induced by seen validation aspect scores
multi_sentiment_decoder.sentiment_threshold_candidates: 65 equally spaced empirical quantiles of seen validation sentiment scores plus a value above the maximum that exactly nests the argmax control
tie_breakers: fewer emitted sentiments per selected aspect

secondary_decoder.name: forced_top2
secondary_decoder.sentiment_rule: always emit the two highest-scoring sentiments for every selected aspect
secondary_decoder.aspect_threshold_objective: end-to-end pair micro-F1 on seen-aspect validation
secondary_decoder.role: stress-test the precision cost of unconditional multi-sentiment output

primary_metric: held-out pair micro-F1, unweighted mean across folds
secondary_metrics: held-out pair micro precision and recall
rate of selected aspects receiving more than one sentiment
gold-sentiment recall on multi-gold review-aspect instances
fold wins ties losses against argmax
stopping_rules: failure to reproduce the parent argmax control
reporting_rule: Retain negative results and do not modify the parent Study C results.
